## Objective
- Continue developing Pond Pals with rebirth progression and a large permanent skill tree.
- Add a shack behind the pond, otters that travel between fish and the shack, correctly oriented swimming fish, and timed random events with a visible flash and countdown.

## Requirements
- Rebirth resets current-run fish and helpers while preserving golden fish and perks.
- Perks cover tap strength, critical chance and damage, otter gathering speed, and other upgrades.
- Show rebirth progress and golden-fish rewards; use 30 perks across five themed groups, with prerequisite chains and multiple ranks.
- Base rebirth target is 10,000 run fish, scaling each rebirth.
- Random events should include effects such as doubling tap power, visibly notify the player, and show remaining time.

## Decisions
- Implement the game in the existing single-page `index.html`.
- Otters should visibly carry fish while traveling from the pond to the shack.
- Random event effects are factored into tap power and helper income.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and browser-verified rebirth progression, permanent perks, persistence, and desktop/mobile skill-tree layouts.
- Added a shack scene model behind the pond.
- Added random event definitions, an event banner, and event multipliers to tap power and gathering income.
- Changed decorative fish rotation from a direction flip to continuous rotation.

### Active
- Finish otter travel behavior between pond and shack; partial movement state and animation logic have been edited but not verified.
- Complete random event timing, countdown display, and event scheduling; only the event starter and banner scaffolding have been added so far.
- Verify fish orientation, event behavior, and scene layout in a browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish event scheduling and per-frame countdown/expiration updates, updating the visible banner with remaining time.
2. Review and complete otter movement transitions, including gathering/delivery cycles and their home positions.
3. Run syntax checks and browser-test the new scene and event behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, Three.js scene, rebirth/perk systems, and in-progress shack, otter, fish, and event changes.

## Important Context
- Prior rebirth/perk work was reported browser-verified; current feature changes have not been tested.
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The in-progress `index.html` edits include an event banner and `startRandomEvent()`, but no timer update or invocation has been added yet.
